initial_context: Before opening the entry URL, no store-specific business or source facts were disclosed; only the URL and task constraints were given.

selection.reason: The compact catalog listed it as the cheapest item, at $0.001 USDC. I used scvd.store as a known x402 host.
selection.guess_and_limit: The quote accepted the host input, but reported that scvd.store has never been observed in the store’s corpus. The resulting signed answer would therefore be not_observed, with no host verdict.

deliverable: An instant, signed certificate-bound copy of the store’s existing dated corpus facts for the host, including observations and gaps. It makes no new probe. The same underlying facts are free at https://scvd.store/corpus/host/scvd.store.json; a purchased certificate would be verifiable at https://scvd.store/api/verify/{cert_id}.
http_402_interpretation: The unsigned request passed input validation and returned an x402 v2 payment quote, not a completed purchase or an error. The PAYMENT-REQUIRED header offered USDC payment terms; completing the purchase would require signing one offer and retrying the same URL with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
tool_output_limit: The first two response displays were truncated by the tool’s output limit; their HTTP requests succeeded. The compact catalog and quote were readable.
